title: Uhlmann Pac-Systeme | LinkedIn
content:
Overview:
Uhlmann Pac-Systeme GmbH & Co. KG is a leading global systems supplier for the packaging of pharmaceutical products in blisters, bottles, and cartons. The company offers flexible integral solutions that meet the challenges of international pharmaceutical companies, generics manufacturers, and contract packers. These include ever higher demands on reliability and cost efficiency, as well as product traceability, which is mandatory in many countries. On the basis of its innovative portfolio, including blister machines, bottle lines, cartoners, and end-of-line packaging machines, Uhlmann has been setting standards in terms of quality, efficiency, and availability for decades. Over time, the company has become a total solution provider: 360° PHARMA PACKAGING stands for consultation, project management, implementation, comprehensive services and digital solutions from a single source. The company, headquartered in Laupheim, Germany, operates worldwide and guarantees close support through twenty sales and services bases. Uhlmann Pac-Systeme GmbH & Co. KG was established in 1948 and is part of the Uhlmann Group, which is in its third generation of family management. The Group has a workforce of around 2,500 and generated sales amounting to EUR 504 million in the business year 2024/25. Further members of the Uhlmann Group are the companies Koch Pac-Systeme and Goldfuß Engineering in Germany, Cremer Speciaalmachines in the Netherlands, Axito in Poland, and Wonder Packing Machinery in China. As of October 2019, appropriate elements of central functions are pooled in the newly formed Uhlmann Group Holding GmbH & Co. KG. After starting out in rented premises, the company moved to a new building in Uhlandstrasse in Laupheim in 1956, which came to be known as Plant 1. Today, Uhlmann’s headquarters are still located in Laupheim, about one kilometer as the crow flies from what was then “Plant 1” in Uhlmannstrasse.
